panels.title: Data freshness & book validity
panels.description: Freshness = server now − latest tick in the selected range; book_valid_share and invalid_book_ticks summarize that range. Invalid books are the engine drop/resync signal; warmup is the latest tick flag.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT exchange, market, symbol, engine_version,
    max(ts) AS last_tick,
    dateDiff('millisecond', max(ts), now64(3)) / 1000.0 AS freshness_s,
    avg(toUInt8(book_valid)) AS book_valid_share,
    argMax(tuple(book_age_ms), tick_ns).1 AS book_age_ms,
    countIf(NOT book_valid) AS invalid_book_ticks,
    argMax(warmup, tick_ns) AS warmup
FROM crypto.features FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND if(${asset:sqlstring} = 'BTC', match(symbol, 'BTC|XBT'), position(symbol, 'ETH') > 0) AND exchange != 'cross'
GROUP BY exchange, market, symbol, engine_version
ORDER BY freshness_s DESC

panels.title: Predicted vs realized return (%)
panels.description: Empty until phase 6. Returns are 100 × (mid(t+h)/mid(t) − 1), aligned to prediction time. Realized values stay NULL until a valid future tick exists. Latest available feature engine version supplies each target price.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prices AS (
    SELECT concat(exchange, '.', market, '.', ${asset:sqlstring}) AS target,
        tick_ns, argMax(mid, tuple(available_ns, engine_version)) AS reference_mid
    FROM crypto.features FINAL
    WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
        AND if(${asset:sqlstring} = 'BTC', match(symbol, 'BTC|XBT'), position(symbol, 'ETH') > 0) AND exchange != 'cross' AND mid IS NOT NULL AND book_valid
    GROUP BY target, tick_ns
)
SELECT p.ts AS time,
    concat(p.target, ' / ', toString(p.horizon_s), 's / ', p.model_version, ' / ', item.1) AS metric,
    item.2 AS value
FROM crypto.predictions AS p FINAL
LEFT JOIN prices AS start ON start.target = p.target AND start.tick_ns = p.tick_ns
LEFT JOIN prices AS finish ON finish.target = p.target
    AND finish.tick_ns = p.tick_ns + toInt64(p.horizon_s) * 1000000000
ARRAY JOIN [
    ('predicted', toNullable(p.pred_return_pct)),
    ('realized', 100.0 * (finish.reference_mid / nullIf(start.reference_mid, 0) - 1.0))
] AS item
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND endsWith(p.target, concat('.', ${asset:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

panels.title: Live predicted vs realized return (%)
panels.description: Versioned Binance references from research/targets.yaml. Exact endpoints; FINAL deduplicates. Hit rate excludes flat realized returns.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prices AS (
    SELECT multiIf(
            exchange = 'binance' AND market = 'spot' AND symbol = 'BTCUSDT', 'BTC_spot',
            exchange = 'binance' AND market = 'perp' AND symbol = 'BTCUSDT', 'BTC_perp',
            exchange = 'binance' AND market = 'spot' AND symbol = 'ETHUSDT', 'ETH_spot',
            exchange = 'binance' AND market = 'perp' AND symbol = 'ETHUSDT', 'ETH_perp', '') AS target,
        tick_ns,
        argMax(mid_e9, tuple(available_ns, engine_version)) AS reference_mid,
        argMax(warmup, tuple(available_ns, engine_version)) AS reference_warmup
    FROM crypto.features FINAL
    WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
        AND book_valid AND mid_e9 > 0
    GROUP BY target, tick_ns
    HAVING target != ''
)
SELECT p.ts AS time,
    concat(p.target, ' / ', toString(p.horizon_s), 's / ', p.model_version, ' / ', item.1) AS metric,
    item.2 AS value
FROM crypto.predictions AS p FINAL
LEFT JOIN prices AS start ON start.target = p.target AND start.tick_ns = p.tick_ns
LEFT JOIN prices AS finish ON finish.target = p.target
    AND finish.tick_ns = p.tick_ns + toInt64(p.horizon_s) * 1000000000
ARRAY JOIN [('predicted', toNullable(p.pred_return_pct)), ('realized', if(start.reference_warmup = 0, 100.0 * (finish.reference_mid / nullIf(start.reference_mid, 0) - 1.0), NULL))] AS item
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND startsWith(p.target, concat(${asset:sqlstring}, '_'))
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

panels.title: Live directional hit rate (%)
panels.description: Versioned Binance references from research/targets.yaml. Exact endpoints; FINAL deduplicates. Hit rate excludes flat realized returns.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prices AS (
    SELECT multiIf(
            exchange = 'binance' AND market = 'spot' AND symbol = 'BTCUSDT', 'BTC_spot',
            exchange = 'binance' AND market = 'perp' AND symbol = 'BTCUSDT', 'BTC_perp',
            exchange = 'binance' AND market = 'spot' AND symbol = 'ETHUSDT', 'ETH_spot',
            exchange = 'binance' AND market = 'perp' AND symbol = 'ETHUSDT', 'ETH_perp', '') AS target,
        tick_ns,
        argMax(mid_e9, tuple(available_ns, engine_version)) AS reference_mid,
        argMax(warmup, tuple(available_ns, engine_version)) AS reference_warmup
    FROM crypto.features FINAL
    WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
        AND book_valid AND mid_e9 > 0
    GROUP BY target, tick_ns
    HAVING target != ''
)
SELECT max(p.ts) AS time,
    concat(p.target, ' / ', toString(p.horizon_s), 's / ', p.model_version) AS metric,
    100.0 * avg(toFloat64(p.direction = sign(finish.reference_mid - start.reference_mid))) AS value
FROM crypto.predictions AS p FINAL
LEFT JOIN prices AS start ON start.target = p.target AND start.tick_ns = p.tick_ns
LEFT JOIN prices AS finish ON finish.target = p.target
    AND finish.tick_ns = p.tick_ns + toInt64(p.horizon_s) * 1000000000
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND startsWith(p.target, concat(${asset:sqlstring}, '_'))
    AND start.reference_warmup = 0 AND start.reference_mid > 0 AND finish.reference_mid > 0
    AND finish.reference_mid != start.reference_mid
GROUP BY p.target, p.horizon_s, p.model_version
ORDER BY metric
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
